Welcome to Cafe Balochistan

Located on Main RCD Road in Hub Chowki, Cafe Balochistan Restaurant is a casual local food destination known for affordable meals, quick service, tea, fast food, BBQ and its popular samosas.

Whether you're stopping for a quick bite, meeting friends, enjoying tea or looking for a satisfying meal while traveling through Hub, Cafe Balochistan offers a variety of familiar Pakistani and local-style favorites.
